review_method: Independent actual-source-pixel review, source-to-code comparison, actual inspection of all ten final PNGs, independent mesh topology check. Focused historical exterior controls, not an exhaustive manufacturing-detail or as-built certification.

view_checks.preview: Complete attached-wing front oblique: 15 shallow arches, open corridor, 165 fins and east gable; no full-view clipping.
view_checks.rear: Complete rear oblique: lower handed compound doors/windows, upper W3 opaque lower panel at west, open triangular west attachment cut.
view_checks.front: Complete south elevation: fifteen shallow R350 arcades and fifteen upper fin groups; not semicircular arches.
view_checks.back: Complete north elevation: ten lower compound door/window groups and five W1, upper fourteen W1 plus west W3.
view_checks.east: Complete blank east gable and lower side arcade portal; no invented upper windows.
view_checks.west: Complete labelled attachment cut, not an independent exterior facade; D1 at upper south interface, no invented old stairs or west gable triangle.
view_checks.top: Complete pitched roof silhouette, derived ridge, graphic tile courses and free eaves.
view_checks.arcade-detail: Intentional local framing: open ground corridor, opposite-handed DW1, narrow leaf vision panels and shallow arch curvature visible.
view_checks.fins-detail: Intentional local framing: eleven narrow vertical fins per upper window, retained separation and top/bottom anchors.
view_checks.interface-detail: Intentional local framing: west D1, differently colored rectangular cut face and unfilled triangular attachment opening; old building excluded.

source_controls_passed: 45x10.45 m new two-storey attached wing, fifteen 3 m bays; five lower classrooms and upper library.
GL .66, 2FL5.28, beam9.28, derived roof wall-axis9.58 and nominal slope-plane ridge12.1925; cap/eaves explicitly graphic.
R350 shallow arcade; 4.18 crown versus 4.16 alternative floor/radius chain preserved as 2 cm datum difference.
165 source 5x20 cm fins, nominal FL5.28..8.58; hidden 2 cm endpoint overlap declared.
W3 full outer frame and opaque lower half, DW1 vision panel and opposite handed leaves, D1 limited to interface.
Seven privately held source sheets correspond to this undated library/classroom project; no dormitory or 1989 identity substitution.
limitations: Not an independent whole building: existing west building/stairs and north repair corridor excluded. West gray cut surface is authored scope boundary, not a historical material inference.
No current-condition, construction-completion or exact-year claim.
Graphic eaves, cap, tile courses, pier width, door position and frame subdivision remain bounded approximations; not all small window rows reproduced to individual dimensions.
1:150 fin thickness about .333 mm is fragile and unprinted. Watertightness is not a fabrication guarantee.
Interior rooms, furniture, hidden structure and existing interface stairs omitted. Original images and crops remain private.
render_provenance: All ten images are final render-v2 for the bound mesh; no older preview images accepted.
